messages:
Alex (eng-infra): Heads-up: after today's VPC hardening push, some APAC GPU nodes are failing healthchecks and not joining the cluster.
Nina (eng-sre): seeing init containers hang on keystore decrypt, node kubelet reports TLS dial timeout to keystore VIP.
Omar (eng-security): we added CIDR deny rules to tighten east-west egress to keystore. Intended to whitelist NLB subnets but looks like new warm-pool ENIs in apac-2 weren't discovered.
Jess (eng-platform): rollback is invasive for audit logs. Can we insert a short-lived allow for the missing ENI range? Need ticket justification.
Alex (eng-infra): applying canary exception now to the policy engine: allow egress to keystore from 10.250.45.0/24 for 20m.
DeployBot: [AUDIT] policy-change by Alex (canary-id: opa-canary-99) TTL=20m
Nina (eng-sre): first node rejoined at +27s after exception applied. join-rate recovering.
Omar (eng-security): filing audit entry INC-5201. Please include cost impact if we had forced cross-region failover.
Jess (eng-platform): quick estimate: avoided ~ $7k/day in cross-region failover and provisioning churn. Adding to ticket.
Alex (eng-infra): follow-ups: (1) update policy discovery to include warm-pool ENIs, (2) add preflight dry-run against current ENI set, (3) improve keystore error surface for authz vs network timeouts. PR: https://git.internal/infra/pulls/501
Nina (eng-sre): monitoring metrics: node_join_rate, keystore_decrypt_errors, audit_sink for exceptions. Will revoke exception after stable window. :thumbsup:
Omar (eng-security): will propose an OPA dry-run workflow for infra pushes this week.
Jess (eng-platform): closing loop: INC-5201 will have timeline, cost estimate, and action items.
